reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding — the issue is the check is NOT called). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; entry point is a public-facing Discord OAuth callback initiated by any Discord user (untrusted). Gate 3: src/app/auth/ is explicitly in-scope and 'Discord membership verification bypass' is listed as a key security concern. An attacker can trigger this via the Discord OAuth callback by completing the standard OAuth flow with valid Discord credentials, causing full authenticated access to be granted despite the user having been removed from the Discord server — the membership check at L106-119 is commented out, leaving only a stale member.members row lookup as the sole gate.
